{{Quote|We'll stop the ship tomorrow night&mdash;after dinner of course. Are the mass mines ready for deployment?|[[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], to [[Goru/Legends|Goru]]|<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|144|Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score}}</ref>}}
The '''mass-shadow mine''',<ref name="Labyrinth">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> also known as the '''mass mine''',<ref name="Insider" /> was a type of [[Space mine/Legends|space mine]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] in order to prevent [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] reinforcements from arriving to aid the defenders of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Labyrinth" />

A later refinement of this technology was the [[Empion mine]] used by the forces of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] and Admiral [[Apwar Trigit]].
